regime_context: The detector shows a broad, two-legged leadership structure in Canada/TSX with Base Metals & Copper narrowly ahead of Oil & Gas Producers (margin 0.19, breadth 0.56, not one-narrative). Rank-IC is essentially zero, so this is an attention map, not a forecast; the only validated edge here is the absolute-trend gate, which gate_helps=true says did reduce drawdown on this market. Track record shows decent hit rate (65.6%) but weak directional accuracy (34.4%), so I keep conviction low and lean on durability/trend-health rather than momentum rank.
emerging_watch: Gold Miners vs Silver & Royalties: both share the XGD.TO proxy and sit at ranks 3 and 4 with low breadth (0.333). I am watching whether Gold Miners' durability_bar (0.49) and Silver's (0.41) both stay below 0.5 while their scores converge — a confirmed handoff between the two precious-metals names would retire this watch, as would either name's durability_bar crossing above 0.55 on its own breadth improvement.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers has the highest durability_bar (0.64) and joint-highest breadth (0.643) among the top ranks, with an eligible true trend-gate reading. While not the rank leader, its durability and breadth legs suggest the leadership is more internally confirmed than the headline Base Metals name, which has a mean-revert hurst tag and lower durability. This is a durability/breadth lean, not a momentum-rank buy.
theses.dissent: Oil & Gas is a global-cyclical, beta-sensitive theme; an unscheduled macro shock (geopolitics share is 0.4) or a commodity-price reversal could knock the whole energy leg despite the strong internal breadth.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO lags the S&P/TSX benchmark by 6% before the 30-day check-by.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is the only crowded theme in the ranks (crowded true, crowding_z 1.22). The guardrails forbid treating crowding as a sell or fade, and forbid fading the dominant theme on a crowding flag — but Technology is NOT the dominant theme (rank 9, score -0.205). It sits mid-pack with negative score and crowded texture, so an 'avoid' lean on a non-leader, crowded, negative-score theme is a sizing caution, not a fade call against leadership.
theses.dissent: Technology breadth is actually high (0.6), and the crowding flag is coincident, not predictive; it could still grind higher on idiosyncratic Canadian tech strength even while crowded.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO outperforms the S&P/TSX by 5% before the 30-day check-by.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
